description: Does a change to the approved thing invalidate the approval under a materiality policy? — Compares what a human or system approved with what is about to be executed (a quote, order, plan, diff summary: any JSON) under a caller-supplied materiality policy: per-path rules exact / ignore / numeric tolerance (absolute or percent) / no-increase / no-decrease, with the longest matching path winning and a default for unlisted paths. Also covers quote revisions (approved revision number must e

asOf.description: RFC 3339 instant for the expiry check; no clock is read.

current.description: The version about to be executed (JSON).

default.description: Rule for paths no field rule covers. Default material (any change invalidates).

path.description: JSON Pointer prefix; "*" matches one token.

pct.description: numeric-tolerance: allowed difference as percent of the approved value. Either bound being met is enough.

requireSameRevision.description: Default true when either revision is given (a missing partner gives unknown): an approval for another revision does not cover this one. Send false to ignore the revisions.

name: approval-invalidation
